title: Shuttles for Hessian and Sacking Looms
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 1186) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Shuttles for Hessian and Sacking Looms.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Accessories for Use in Shuttles for Jute Looms

clause_3_terminology: Shuttles for Hessian and Sacking Looms

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
